answer: Consider an agent economy that gates voting on proven labour rather than mere accounts. A newcomer must finish six blind jobs checked by three unrelated reviewers, stake 30 units for two epochs, and gather four endorsements from established identities. A clone must repeat every audit and lock its own collateral; a failed review destroys it. Because receipts are unique and endorsements must be diverse, no swarm can recycle credibility, and swarm size drives cost up faster than reward. anchor raven forge
